Benfica season|2022–23]] | nextseason = [[2024–25 S.L. Benfica season|2024–25]] }} The 2023–24 [[S.L. Benfica|Sport Lisboa e Benfica]] season was the club's [[List of S.L. Benfica seasons|120th season]] in existence and its 90th consecutive season in the top flight of [[Football in Portugal|Portuguese football]]. Domestically, Benfica played in the [[2023–24 Primeira Liga|Primeira Liga]] as defending champions, and reached the semi-finals of the [[2023–24 Taça da Liga|Taça da Liga]] and [[2023–24 Taça de Portugal|Taça de Portugal]]. In Europe, Benfica played in the [[2023–24 UEFA Champions League group stage|UEFA Champions League group stage]] before reaching the [[2023–24 UEFA Europa League knockout phase|UEFA Europa League quarter-finals]]. The season started on 9 August 2023, with a 2–0 win over [[FC Porto|Porto]] in the [[2023 Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira|Supertaça match]], and concluded on 17 May 2024, with a second-place finish in Primeira Liga.
